## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a relevant issue if one exists.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. Explain skipped checks. Distinguish
offline fixtures, synthetic native UI/decoder checks, and authorized live testing.

## Limitations

Mention compatibility, performance, security, or packaging implications when
relevant. Delete this section if there are none.

- [ ] Relevant regression coverage and documentation are included.
- [ ] The diff and attachments contain no credentials, encrypted profiles, keys,
      private addresses/hostnames, private captures, or generated build artifacts.
- [ ] Added third-party code/assets have provenance and license notices; applicable
      dependency or codec source materials are updated.
